parse.title: Beast Form Vampire
parse.wikitext:
[[File:Beast-Form-Vampire.png|thumb|A Beast Form Vampire.]]
The Beast Form Vampire is a very rare, high-level NPC resembling the giant bat form of the Original Vampires, but without wings. It typically spawns at levels 8,000 to 12,000.

== How it spawns ==
If a player donates blood to a vampire hunter NPC, there is a small chance the NPC will suddenly feed on another vampire hunter or a nearby human NPC. When it feeds, it transforms into the Beast Form Vampire.

== Purpose ==
It can be killed to grind EXP and level up. However, it is extremely rare, so finding one may take time.
